story.title: AI voice startup Vapi hits $500M valuation after beating 40 rivals to win Amazon Ring as client
story.summary: AI voice infrastructure startup Vapi has reached a $500 million valuation after winning Amazon Ring as a client in a competitive evaluation against more than 40 rival platforms. Vapi says its enterprise business has grown tenfold since early 2025 as companies shift customer support and sales functions to AI voice agents. The Amazon Ring win gives Vapi a marquee reference customer and signals accelerating enterprise adoption of AI-driven phone and voice interactions.
